name: Agent Network
description: Let coding agents in an Orca workspace message each other: installs the teammate instructions for each harness and shows the agents of every workspace and their latest messages.

cover.alt: The Network panel listing five agents of different harnesses and their messages, beside a Claude Code prompt asking Codex for a review.

screenshots.alt: The dark Network panel: five agents, two Working and three Done, above the feed of messages they exchanged.
screenshots.caption: Every agent, one network

screenshots.alt: The same Network panel in Orca's light theme.
screenshots.caption: Follows Orca's theme

screenshots.alt: The Instructions group, unfolded, showing the teammate skill installed for Claude Code, Codex and DSH, Grok and Antigravity.
screenshots.caption: One click teaches every harness
